rules.message: Force-pushing rewrites shared history. Confirm before running it.
This looks like a private key. Do not write credentials into files or commands.
This project uses its logger module instead of console.log.
Files in src/generated are generated. Change the generator and run npm run codegen instead.
Do not leave debugger statements in code or suggest them in answers.
The test run reported failures. Fix them before moving on, and do not say the tests pass.
